opal_data_etfs_silver_bbg_characteristic.reason: the CRO spec proposes no tool for the Bloomberg characteristics table (existing etfs_get_positioning verdict keep)

opal_data_etfs_silver_bbg_constituents_i.reason: the CRO spec proposes no tool for the issuer-fill copy of silver/holdings (existing etfs_get_positioning verdict keep)

opal_data_etfs_silver_bbg_derived_geo_al.reason: the CRO spec proposes etfs_get_fund_bloomberg_characteristics, which reads the fund's geography allocation for one as-of date

opal_data_etfs_silver_bbg_derived_sector.reason: the CRO spec proposes etfs_get_fund_bloomberg_characteristics, which reads the fund's sector allocation for one as-of date

opal_data_etfs_silver_bbg_derived_summar.reason: the CRO spec proposes etfs_get_fund_bloomberg_characteristics, which reads the holdings count and top-10 weight for one as-of date

opal_data_etfs_silver_bbg_fund_daily.reason: the CRO spec proposes etfs_get_fund_bloomberg_characteristics, which reads the fund's Bloomberg daily row for one as-of date

opal_data_etfs_silver_bbg_history_topup.reason: the CRO spec proposes no tool for the security price history top-up (existing etfs_get_positioning verdict keep)

opal_data_etfs_silver_bloomberg_etf_hold.reason: a rival-funds silver that is the input of gold canonical_shape; the CRO G5r spec serves the rival holdings from canonical_shape, so this silver has no tool of its own

opal_data_etfs_silver_bloomberg_history_.reason: the CRO spec proposes no tool: a single unattributed ops artifact (producer not attributed)

opal_data_etfs_silver_etf_history_csv.reason: the CRO spec proposes no tool: a CSV duplicate of netassets_daily.parquet (read the parquet)

opal_data_etfs_silver_issuer_site_holdin.reason: a rival-funds silver that is the input of gold canonical_shape; the CRO spec proposes no tool for it, and G5r serves the rival holdings from canonical_shape

opal_data_etfs_silver_netassets.reason: superseded: the CRO spec names silver/netassets_daily as the one-read backing for NAV ranges since 2026-07-09, and the merged etfs_get_fund_nav_history reads that daily table

opal_data_etfs_silver_snapshots.reason: the CRO spec's snapshot question (a fund's NAV and net assets on the last run) needs a per-run-date record reader; built as etfs_get_fund_snapshot because the spec's name etfs_get_fund_nav_history is taken by the merged NAV tool
